hypothesis: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT 15m perpetual futures have positive net expectancy after fees, slippage and actual funding when entering long at a causal third buy point (third-buy: an upward departure from a valid central zone followed by a pullback whose low remains strictly above the zone upper bound), and the signal beats an unconditional 24-hour long baseline in the same symbols and period.

data.source: Binance official monthly USD-M kline and fundingRate archives
data.why_unseen: Repository audit found pre-2024 use only from 2023-10 onward (smoke tests, T28 warmup from 2023-11, Jindan V3 warmup from 2023-11). This window ends 2023-09-30, before all of those records.
data.missing_policy: No interpolation or zero fill. Skip any signal/trade whose required lookback, entry or exit bars are missing. Exclude trades with missing funding at a crossed settlement.
data.checksum: Verify official .CHECKSUM for every monthly archive; record SHA-256 in data_manifest.json.

rules.bar_handling: raw closed 15m bars; no inclusion merging; this is an explicit simplification of traditional chanlun

fractal.confirmation: confirmed at close of bar i+2

stroke.same_type_rule: keep the more extreme fractal (higher top / lower bottom)
stroke.signal_emission: only when a new opposite stroke is appended; a same-type extension updates the last stroke but emits no duplicate signal
stroke.causality: incremental processing in confirmation order; later fractals cannot rewrite an already emitted signal

central_zone.usage: the three strokes immediately before the departure stroke; no zone extension

conditions: departure ends at a top and departure.high > ZG
pullback ends at a bottom and pullback.low > ZG strictly
pullback bottom fractal confirmed at signal bar t

entry.skip_if: entry <= initial stop, or entry <= ZG (gap back into the central zone)

atr.use: ATR at signal bar t, only bars up to t

rules.holding_limit_convention: entry bar is bar 1; time exit at close of bar 96
rules.forward_window: signals without 96 complete bars after entry are excluded, not partially scored
rules.gap_policy: open <= stop exits at open; open >= target exits at target; no favorable gap credit

costs.funding: actual Binance funding at 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC while held; long pays positive rate and receives negative rate; missing settlement excludes the trade

baseline.definition: unconditional long: every bar with 96 forward bars, enter next open + 2bps, exit close of bar 96 - 2bps, same fees and funding
baseline.comparison: signal mean minus baseline mean, paired by entry UTC week where a signal exists

decision.inconclusive: trades < 30, or positive point estimate with a confidence interval crossing zero
decision.reject: mean_net_return_pct <= 0, or profit_factor <= 1, or no positive excess over baseline

limitations: Raw-bar fractals without inclusion merging are a simplified chanlun, not the full traditional framework.
Only BTC/ETH, long-only, 15m; results do not generalize to other symbols, timeframes or short side.
0.1% fee and 2bps slippage are research assumptions, not verified account terms; no order book, queue or partial fills.
The simple equity curve is trade-close based, not a full mark-to-market portfolio drawdown.
2020-2023 covers multiple regimes but remains a single market and two assets; it is not a guarantee of future performance.
